_comment: Settings for the HTML page and the daily briefing email. Edit freely.
_subscribe: Daily briefing sign-up box. Set ONE of these. subscribe_url: a newsletter provider's form/endpoint (Buttondown, Mailchimp, Formspree, a Microsoft/Google Form...) that accepts a POSTed 'email' field. subscribe_email: your own address; the box opens a pre-filled email to you, and you add the person with 'secnews subscribers add'. Leave both empty to show a 'not connected yet' message.
_focus: The briefing leads with these topics (ids from categories.json, see 'secnews categories'). If fewer than briefing_min_focus_stories are new, it tops up with focus stories from the last briefing_catchup_days that haven't been sent yet, then adds briefing_general_stories of the day's biggest other stories. Set briefing_focus to [] for a general briefing.
_timezone: Used for the date in the subject line and for 'secnews briefing --at 09:00'. Any IANA name, e.g. Europe/London, Europe/Warsaw, America/New_York.
